risks.risk: Storage capacity may not be 1TB (could be 500GB/other).
risks.proof: A photo/video of the Xbox Settings → System → Storage screen showing total capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as the lowest likely capacity for an Xbox One S bundle (treat as not confirmed 1TB).

risks.risk: Games installed may be different from what the buyer expects, or none may be installed.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the Xbox home screen or My Games & Apps showing installed titles.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as console + controller only (treat installed games as not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Ports may be faulty (HDMI/USB/Ethernet) even if the console powers on.
risks.proof: Video showing HDMI connected to a TV and at least one USB device/controller recognized; ideally a quick menu navigation test.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as worst case: ports not fully confirmed (treat as needing buyer to test/possible partial faults).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues or prior repair may exist despite the seller’s statement.
risks.proof: A short gameplay/benchmark clip (10–20 minutes) with no shutdowns plus a photo of any warranty/serial sticker intact.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not proven healthy thermals (treat as higher risk of faults).

risks.risk: Bundle completeness: missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable, original pads/receipt).
risks.proof: Photo of everything laid out (console, controller, power brick/cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable, any included accessories) and receipt/packaging if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as console + controller only (treat missing accessories as likely).

proof_requests: Photo/video of Xbox Settings → System → Storage showing the exact capacity (confirm 1TB).
Photo/video of the Xbox dashboard or My Games & Apps showing installed games.
Close-up photos of all ports (front and back) and a short test video with HDMI to a TV and controller working.
Photo of the power/serial label (or system info screen) and any evidence of receipt/packaging if available.
Lay-out photo of all included items (power/HDMI/controller accessories) to confirm bundle completeness.
response.reason: The seller’s reply asserts testing, but without new photos/videos the key items that affect price (1TB confirmation, installed games, port functionality, and bundle completeness/receipt) remain unverified from the provided images.
